findings.summary: artist_music.id is UUID; sound recording FK must be uuid
Phase 1 trust/cert stack exists and is flag-gated off by default
No general outbox; Phase 2 must add music_rights_outbox_events
Artist music APIs are owner-scoped; contributor access must be added
E-sign is first-party clickwrap only; no DocuSign
No music_rights_* tables, C2PA, watermark, or blockchain code present

blockers.summary: Sepolia deployer keys may be absent
blockers.safe_state: flag off; passport valid without anchor

architecture_decisions.title: Rights schema and naming
architecture_decisions.decision: Use public schema with music_rights_* table prefix matching Phase 1 music_* conventions.

architecture_decisions.title: Track-to-recording cardinality
architecture_decisions.decision: One primary music_rights_sound_recordings row per artist_music (artist_music_id uuid unique); special relationships via music_rights_asset_relationships.

architecture_decisions.title: Electronic signature provider
architecture_decisions.decision: First-party Tourify e-sign ceremony extending agreement.service clickwrap with reauth, claim snapshots, and sealed private copies. No third-party vendor in Phase 2.

architecture_decisions.title: Credential format and signing suite
architecture_decisions.decision: W3C VC 2.0-compatible JSON envelope; Ed25519 issuer key from server env; DB credential status list.

architecture_decisions.title: C2PA audio toolchain and format matrix
architecture_decisions.decision: C2PA adapter + async worker; WAV embedded + MP3 sidecar; lazy SDK; failure leaves clean master untouched.

architecture_decisions.title: Watermark and monitoring adapters
architecture_decisions.decision: Watermark adapter interface with noop + opt-in beta_stub; monitoring matches require human review.

architecture_decisions.title: Testnet and attestation registry
architecture_decisions.decision: EVM Sepolia testnet; immutable V1 OpenZeppelin AccessControl registry; mainnet disabled; off-chain passport remains valid if anchor pending/failed.

architecture_decisions.title: Key management and rotation
architecture_decisions.decision: Dev/test env secrets; prod KMS/HSM runbook; separate issuer/C2PA/chain keys; never client-exposed.

architecture_decisions.title: Evidence retention and deletion
architecture_decisions.decision: Private buckets music-rights-evidence, music-rights-documents, music-rights-exports; append-only audit/signature events; retain until owner delete subject to legal hold.

architecture_decisions.title: DDEX target standards and versions
architecture_decisions.decision: DDEX-aligned identifier fields (ISRC/ISWC/UPC concepts); no full ERN/MWDR export automation in Phase 2.

risks.mitigation: Tiered claims, agreements, contributor confirmation, counsel-approved copy, suspension and dispute workflow.
Private storage, strict RLS, narrow APIs, redaction, access logging, security testing.
Additive schema, feature flags, regression suite, no second player/catalog.

risks.description: Electronic signature evidence is legally or technically insufficient
risks.mitigation: Counsel review, ADR, reproducible document snapshots, reauthentication and audit evidence.

risks.description: AI detector false positive or evasion
risks.mitigation: No detector-only decision, manual review, source evidence, appeal, private scores.

risks.description: C2PA/watermark transformations reduce audio quality or fail through codecs
risks.mitigation: Clean-master separation, format matrix, blind listening, codec robustness, opt-in beta.
Separate managed keys, multisig, least privilege, pause/revoke and incident runbook.

risks.description: Artists misunderstand rights reservation as guaranteed prevention
risks.mitigation: Precise language, product education, no guarantee, layered controls.

risks.description: Review operations are too expensive or slow
risks.mitigation: Structured intake, automated objective checks, plan-based SLA, pilot measurement.

risks.description: Phase 2 becomes coupled to financial tokens
risks.mitigation: Bounded contexts, no wallet requirement, no payout/valuation fields in core rights domain.
